name: Observability
description: Structured JSON logging, correlation IDs via AsyncLocalStorage, request logger middleware, /api/health endpoint
checklist: Merge .env.observability.example into .env.local (all vars are optional — the logger has defaults)
Wire requestLoggerMiddleware into your server (Express) or call runWithContext/getOrCreateCorrelationId from a Next.js middleware/route wrapper
Visit http://localhost:3000/api/health — extend its checks array as you add Redis/Supabase/LLM templates
Set LOG_LEVEL=debug to see all request logs; check responses for the correlation header (default x-request-id)

If you enabled OTel: npm install @opentelemetry/sdk-node @opentelemetry/exporter-trace-otlp-http @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node, then merge .env.otel.example and set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
